display.purpose: The single document H1 and standalone title.

headline.purpose: H2 section boundaries in long technical documents.

title.purpose: H3 subsection boundaries and focused evidence groups.

label.purpose: Captions, provenance, control labels, and compact metadata.

components.name: Document Surface
components.description: Canonical centered reading surface with bounded prose and wider evidence regions.
components.html:
Document title

Purpose appears before exhaustive navigation.

Long-form technical content stays calm and readable.
components.css: .ds-document-surface { box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 72rem; margin-inline: auto; padding: clamp(calc(var(--spacing) * 5), 4vw, calc(var(--spacing) * 12)); color: var(--color-on-surface); background: var(--color-surface); font: 1rem/1.6 var(--font-body); } .ds-document-surface h1 { max-width: 24ch; margin: 0 0 calc(var(--spacing) * 6); color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); font: var(--font-weight-bold) var(--text-4xl)/var(--text-4xl--line-height) var(--font-title); letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-document-surface p { max-width: 75ch; } .ds-document-surface .ds-lead { color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); font-size: 1.125rem; }

components.name: Table of Contents
components.description: Progressive long-document navigation; title and purpose remain first on narrow screens.
components.html:
Contents
  1. Section one
  2. Section two
components.css: .ds-contents { max-width: 72rem; color: var(--color-on-surface); font: 1rem/1.5 var(--font-body); } .ds-contents details { border: 1px solid var(--color-outline); border-radius: var(--radius-radius); background: var(--color-surface); } .ds-contents summary { min-height: 44px; padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 3); color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold); cursor: pointer; } .ds-contents ol { margin: 0; padding: 0 calc(var(--spacing) * 5) calc(var(--spacing) * 4); } .ds-contents a { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: var(--color-primary); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-contents summary:focus-visible, .ds-contents a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Figure Caption
components.description: One caption treatment shared by images, static charts, interactive charts, and diagrams.
components.css: .ds-figure { max-width: 100%; margin: calc(var(--spacing) * 6) 0; } .ds-figure-placeholder { min-height: 10rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-outline); border-radius: var(--radius-radius); background: var(--color-surface-alt); } .ds-figure figcaption { max-width: 80%; margin: calc(var(--spacing) * 2) auto 0; color: var(--color-on-surface); font: italic var(--text-sm)/1.4 var(--font-body); text-align: center; }

components.name: Exact Data Table
components.description: Visible HTML data companion shared by static and interactive charts; print visibility is separately gated.
components.css: .ds-data-table { max-width: 100%; margin-block: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-data-table table { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-outline); border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--color-on-surface); background: var(--color-surface); font: var(--text-sm)/1.5 var(--font-body); text-align: left; } .ds-data-table caption { padding-block: 0.5rem; color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold); text-align: left; } .ds-data-table thead { background: var(--color-surface-alt); } .ds-data-table th, .ds-data-table td { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--color-outline); padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; text-align: left; }

components.name: Document Disclosure
components.description: Native progressive disclosure for secondary technical material, never a duplicate of visible content.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { max-width: 75ch; margin-block: calc(var(--spacing) * 6); padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 4); border: 1px solid var(--color-outline); border-radius: var(--radius-radius); color: var(--color-on-surface); background: var(--color-surface-alt); } .ds-disclosure summary { min-height: 44px; color: var(--color-on-surface-strong); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold); cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Margo turns one semantic Markdown document into trustworthy HTML and later PDF projections. HTML is the canonical visual surface; print may change pagination, ink behavior, and page furniture, but never hierarchy or meaning. Goshtoso remains visual authority while Margo adds document roles, prose rhythm, responsive reading behavior, and pagination.
keyCharacteristics: One semantic source and one visual hierarchy across HTML and PDF.
Quiet surfaces, strong type hierarchy, readable measure, and sparse accent.
Flat composition using spacing, rules, and tonal contrast instead of cards.
Captions, tables, charts, and diagrams are first-class reading content.
Light and dark modes preserve hierarchy and geometry.

rules.name: The HTML-First Rule
rules.body: If content or semantics matter in PDF, they must exist in canonical HTML first.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Margo-authored CSS uses Goshtoso semantic tokens.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Ordinary prose stays within 65-75ch; evidence may use wider bounded regions.

rules.name: The Local Overflow Rule
rules.body: Wide content owns its overflow; the page never does.

rules.name: The One Geometry Rule
rules.body: Static and interactive forms of the same content use the same caption, table, border, and spacing geometry.

dos: Do begin every visual decision in semantic HTML and project it to print.
Do reuse Goshtoso tokens and components before adding Margo document roles.
Do make title, purpose, and reading path clear in the first mobile viewport.
Do preserve exact-data tables in HTML and gate print visibility with the accessibility flag, off by default.
donts: Don't create a second visual system that fights Goshtoso.
Don't let watermarks or fixed furniture overlap document content.
Don't expose both a data accordion and a visible exact-data table.
Don't style static and interactive chart captions differently.
Don't add PDF-only content semantics absent from HTML.
